description: Infrastructures de recharge pour : Réseau ÉlectriCité Seine Aval is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vianney DEVIENNE. Electricity Seine Aval is a public electric charging network for electric vehicles and plug-in hybrids. This network, which will be formed by 2016 of more than 50 terminals, extends over the territory of Seine Aval, north of the Yvelines (78). Coverage: Vianney DEVIENNE. The portal shows the English title as "Charging infrastructure for electric vehicles: Electricity network Seine Aval" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vianney DEVIENNE. Its keywords include infrastructure-de-recharge, borne-de-recharge, irve, epamsa, electricite-seine-aval, vehicule-electrique. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by-sa). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
